module purpose: neorv32_cpu is a CPU-core wrapper that instantiates the frontend, control, counters, regfile, ALU, LSU, and optional PMP and ICC blocks, wires their internal datapaths together, and exports instruction/data bus requests and optional ICC traffic. Locally it forms the machine-interrupt vector, combines extension CSR contribution words into xcsr_res, combines write-back sources into rf_wdata, and routes an optional PMP fault indication.

use-case flows.value: three-bit machine-interrupt vector formed from mti_i, mei_i, and msi_i and delivered to the control block
combined extension CSR contribution word formed by OR-ing xcsr_cnt, xcsr_alu, xcsr_pmp, and xcsr_icc for the control block
register-file write-back word formed from alu_res, lsu_rdata, csr_rdata, and ctrl.pc_ret and sent to the regfile
optional PMP fault indication delivered to the control and LSU blocks, or forced to zero when PMP is disabled

conceptual assets.reasoning: The start flow forms `irq_machine <= mti_i & mei_i & msi_i` at line 276. The map records SOURCES from msi_i, mei_i, and mti_i to irq_machine at occurrence 2 of each input, and irq_machine DERIVES_FROM those inputs at occurrence 3. The resulting vector is then consumed by the control block through `irq_machine_i => irq_machine` at line 267 (CONNECTS on irq_machine occurrence 2). Integrity matters because the control block must receive the exact current three source bits; availability is also established because the vector is combinational while the inputs are present.

The operate flow defines `xcsr_res <= xcsr_cnt or xcsr_alu or xcsr_pmp or xcsr_icc` at line 279, and the control block consumes that word through `xcsr_rdata_i => xcsr_res` at line 264. The map records xcsr_res DERIVES_FROM the four contributors at occurrence 3. xcsr_cnt, xcsr_pmp, and xcsr_icc are conditionally supplied by sub-units at lines 299, 416, and 445, and are forced to zero when their features are disabled at lines 305, 426, and 454; xcsr_alu is supplied by the ALU at line 371. Integrity requires the control block to receive exactly the OR-combined word defined by the active configuration; availability is established as the enabled contribution or zero when a feature is disabled.

The operate flow defines `rf_wdata <= alu_res or lsu_rdata or csr_rdata or ctrl.pc_ret` at line 330 and delivers the result to the regfile through `rd_i => rf_wdata` at line 323. The map records rf_wdata DERIVES_FROM alu_res, lsu_rdata, csr_rdata, and ctrl.pc_ret at occurrence 3; alu_res, lsu_rdata, and csr_rdata arrive from sub-unit outputs at lines 369, 388, and 263. Integrity requires the regfile consumer to receive exactly this locally combined write-back word; availability is combinational. `ctrl.pc_ret` is also a direct contributor on line 330, but the map provides only the whole-record connection `ctrl_o => ctrl` at line 253 and no field-level CONNECTS record for ctrl.pc_ret, so its edge is null.

When PMP is enabled, the PMP block drives `fault_o => pmp_fault` at line 420, and both the control block and LSU consume it through `pmp_fault_i => pmp_fault` at lines 257 and 392. When PMP is disabled, the wrapper forces `pmp_fault <= '0'` at line 427. Integrity requires those consumers to receive the exact fault indication selected by configuration; availability is established as the produced flag when `RISCV_ISA_Smpmp` is true and as the forced zero when it is false.
